part1_l2_diagnosis.verdict: live view requires per-document mutation scoping — exactly what M1 L2 full (Rc<RefCell<Document>> per iframe) solves. Minimal slice cannot bypass it.
design_inputs_for_m1: mutations must carry owner-document scope (or per-iframe queues)
handle-based detached trees (_handleChildNodes registry) and sel-based queries are two parallel data sources — L2 must unify via shared live Document
full-replay (not incremental) is a hard constraint of apply_dom_mutations handle scoping; persistent handle map needed for incremental

part2_landed.indexed_props: _zwMakeCollection: each index 0..n-1 becomes a configurable:false accessor (get returns snapshotted element — snapshot avoids self-recursive getter when a===arr; guard skips already-wrapped arrays). delete c[0] is a no-op in loose mode, throws TypeError in strict (legacy platform object). Plain arrays hole-punch on delete making c[0] permanently undefined.
part2_landed.named_getter: HTMLCollection named properties: each element's id/name exposed as configurable:false accessor (c.foo hits <i id=foo>; delete no-op / strict TypeError). First-hit-wins in document order.
part2_landed.numeric_key_skip: pure-numeric ids are NOT exposed via named getter: defining a numeric-key accessor on an array pushes length to index+1 (JS semantics), and spec keeps named vs indexed distinct (getElementsByClassName-32 'does not get confused by numeric IDs' asserts length and map ids unaffected).

regression.dom_nodes_polyfill: 2503P unchanged (numeric-id length bug caught via +4-line probe diff, fixed in-round)

process_note: numeric-id length regression (2503->2502) caught by before/after per-subtest diff of full dom/nodes output; root cause = JS array defineProperty numeric key grows length; fixed by skipping numeric named keys.
